title: Sourdough Lab
blurb: Hydration and fermentation math as editable Python that runs in your browser.
goodFor: Books with code readers can edit and run in the browser.
notFor: Small, fast sites: the Python lab is 82 MB.

title: Pocket Tides
blurb: Moon and sun sliders drive a live 3D tide model.
goodFor: Real-time 3D you can steer with sliders.
notFor: Quick lessons: it is the most code of the six.

title: Coffee Atlas
blurb: A structured reference of origins and brew methods.
goodFor: Reference docs and API lookup, for Python, C++ and other languages.

title: Window Garden
blurb: A short guide to what grows on a sill, with live slider-driven charts.
goodFor: Lessons and courses written in plain text, with charts that react.
notFor: Heavy custom apps; interactivity comes from embedded code or other tools.

title: Lemonade Lab
blurb: Mix a pitcher with sliders; reactive Python running in your browser.
goodFor: Python simulations with sliders, no server needed.
notFor: Fast first loads or multi-page sites.

title: Starling Sky
blurb: A flock of birds you can tune and scare. Plain JavaScript animation.
goodFor: Animations and visuals you can drag and tweak, with no build step.
notFor: Page structure: p5 draws, so you build the pages around it.
